# Democracy Now!

> Independent daily news show featuring investigative journalism, international reporting, and in-depth interviews on geopolitics, democracy, and human rights.

Democracy Now! is a listener-supported, independent daily news program hosted by Amy Goodman and Juan González. The site provides access to daily broadcasts, investigative reports, documentary journalism, and coverage of global events with a focus on underreported stories and marginalized voices.

## Key Topics

- Independent journalism
- Daily news broadcast
- Amy Goodman
- Juan González
- Iran conflict
- Middle East geopolitics
- Voting rights
- U.S. foreign policy
- International news
- Investigative reporting
- Democracy and human rights
- Gaza and Palestine
- Venezuela
- Cuba
- Fossil fuels and energy

## Core Access & Navigation

- [Homepage](https://www.democracynow.org): Main entry point to Democracy Now! with latest news, broadcasts, and featured stories
- [Show Archive](https://www.democracynow.org/shows): Complete archive of daily news broadcasts and documentary journalism episodes
- [Subscribe To Digest](https://www.democracynow.org/subscribe): Email newsletter subscription and RSS/podcast access for Democracy Now! content
- [Locate A Station](https://www.democracynow.org/stations): Station locator for broadcast distribution across radio, TV, and internet platforms

## Investigative Reports & Analysis

- [Labor Icon Dolores Huerta, 95, Reveals She, Too, Was Raped by Cesar Chavez](https://www.democracynow.org/2026/3/20/dolores_huerta_cesar_chavez): Investigative report on Cesar Chavez sexual abuse allegations featuring labor icon Dolores Huerta
- [Report from Beirut: 1,000+ Dead, 1M+ Displaced, Many Fear Long-Term Occupation](https://www.democracynow.org/2026/3/20/lebanon_israel): On-ground reporting from Beirut on humanitarian crisis and displacement in Lebanon
- [Disenfranchise Tens of Millions? Trump's SAVE Act Targets Women, Poor, Rural & Trans](https://www.democracynow.org/2026/3/20/save_america_act_voting_rights): Analysis of Trump-backed SAVE Act voter ID bill and its voter suppression impacts
- [From Iraq to Iran to Venezuela: Antonia Juhasz on U.S. Quest for Fossil Fuel Dominance](https://www.democracynow.org/2026/3/10/from_iraq_to_iran_to_venezuela): Investigative analysis by Antonia Juhasz on U.S. fossil fuel agenda in Iran war
- [War on Iran Is Part of U.S. Plan for Global Domination: Economist Michael Hudson](https://www.democracynow.org/2026/3/4/war_on_iran_is_part_of): Economic analysis by Michael Hudson on U.S.-Israeli war on Iran and global implications

## Expert Interviews & Commentary

- [Iran Is Playing the Long Game: Prof. Vali Nasr on Protracted War in Middle East](https://www.democracynow.org/2026/3/19/vali_nasr_iran_middle_east): Expert interview with Vali Nasr on Iran's long-term strategy in Middle East conflict
- [Amnesty Head Agnès Callamard on Assassination of Iraqi Feminist Yanar Mohammed](https://www.democracynow.org/2026/3/9/amnesty_head_agnes_callamard_on_assassination): Interview with Amnesty International on Yanar Mohammed assassination and women's rights
- [Filmmaker Geeta Gandbhir Makes History with Oscar Nominations for Two Documentaries](https://www.democracynow.org/2026/3/4/filmmaker_geeta_gandbhir_makes_history_with): Interview with Oscar-nominated filmmaker Geeta Gandbhir on documentary achievements
